_about: Steps and sources shown on the 'Get my records' page. Add a source here; no code change needed. mode: auto = the app does it over USB; addon = needs a helper app on the phone first; hitl = you open the app or site and tap, the app saves what you see. status: ready | planned.

steps.name: Connect your phone
steps.what: Plug in the USB cable, unlock the phone and tap Allow when it asks about USB debugging.
steps.gets: A working link to the phone.

steps.name: Recordings, photos and videos
steps.what: Copies only what is new since the last time, then writes a SHA-256 fingerprint for every file.
steps.gets: Voice recordings, camera photos and videos, with their true dates.

steps.name: Text messages (SMS/MMS)
steps.what: Many phones let the app read texts straight over the cable, including long texts saved as MMS. If yours does not, install a helper app (for example SMS Backup & Restore), make a backup, and the app copies that file.
steps.gets: Every text with sender, time and pictures.

steps.name: Call log and caller ID
steps.what: Uses the same backup app for the call log. If a caller-ID app (for example Truecaller) is installed, its export is copied too.
steps.gets: Who called, when and for how long, with names where the caller-ID app knows them.

steps.name: Notes, calendar and tasks
steps.what: You ask your account for its own export (for example Google Takeout). The app takes the downloaded file.
steps.gets: What you wrote down and when.

steps.name: Caregiver time app (payroll agency)
steps.what: You open the app on the phone and go to each pay period. The app saves each screen as you go. It never taps Submit or Sign; you do.
steps.gets: Shifts, approvals and notes as the agency sees them.

steps.name: Patient portal (MyChart and similar)
steps.what: Best: ask the portal for its full export and give the app the file. Or open each visit yourself and the app saves the visit summary.
steps.gets: Visits, notes, medicines and test results. Duplicate copies of the same visit are counted once.

steps.name: Pharmacies (CVS, Walgreens and others)
steps.what: You log in to the pharmacy site or app yourself and open the prescription history. The app saves what is on screen.
steps.gets: Fill dates, medicines and prescribers.

steps.name: Secure email (Zix and similar)
steps.what: Agencies often send 'secure' messages you can only read on a website. You log in; the app saves each message you open, with a fingerprint.
steps.gets: The agency's own words, kept even after the website deletes them.

steps.name: Speaker names (optional)
steps.what: Accept the speaker model's terms once on its website, in your own browser, and save a free token. The model then runs on this computer.
steps.gets: Transcripts that say who is talking.

steps.name: Medicare claims (Blue Button)
steps.what: Log in to Medicare.gov yourself and use 'Download claims'. The app takes the file.
steps.gets: Every billed visit and service, by date and provider.

steps.name: Health apps and devices
steps.what: Export from Apple Health, Health Connect, Samsung Health, Fitbit, or a blood-pressure cuff, pulse oximeter or glucose app.
steps.gets: Vitals, sleep and readings with timestamps.

steps.name: Location history
steps.what: Export the phone's Maps Timeline (Settings, Location, Timeline). Life360 and Waze recents with you in the loop.
steps.gets: Trips to appointments, with times.

steps.name: App usage and notifications (Android)
steps.what: Read-only over the cable: when each app was opened and when notifications arrived.
steps.gets: Proof of when a message came in or an app was used.

steps.name: Voicemail
steps.what: Visual voicemail files over the cable where the phone allows; Google Voice through its export.
steps.gets: Messages left, with time and caller.

steps.name: Other messages and video calls
steps.what: WhatsApp per-chat export, Signal's own backup, Messenger and Instagram downloads, Zoom, Meet and Teams logs. iPhone call and FaceTime records come from an encrypted local backup.
steps.gets: Messages and calls outside regular texts (who, when, how long).

steps.name: Voice assistants and home cameras
steps.what: Request your Alexa or Google Assistant history; save clips from Ring, Wyze, Nest or Blink.
steps.gets: Requests and visits, with times.

steps.name: Downloads, scans and signed forms
steps.what: The phone's Downloads folder and scanner apps over the cable; DocuSign, Drive, Keep and Notes through their exports.
steps.gets: Saved letters, scanned paper and signed forms.

steps.name: Rides and supplies
steps.what: Ride receipts (Uber, Lyft, medical transport) and online order history for care supplies.
steps.gets: Rides that match appointments; supplies bought and when.

steps.name: Health plan and Medicaid portals
steps.what: Log in yourself; the app saves the claims and authorizations you open.
steps.gets: What the plan approved, denied or paid.

steps.name: Any other site or app
steps.what: Same as above: you open it, the app saves what you see and when.
steps.gets: Hospice, insurance, Medicaid or Medicare sites, and more.
